fix_pdb_file: fix a PDB file by replacing nonstandard residues, removing heterogens, adding missing atoms and hydrogens
clean_pdb_structure: clean an OpenMM PDB structure by replacing selenium in MET residues and removing single-residue chains
remove_heterogens_from_fixer: remove heterogen residues from a PDBFixer instance and track which residue names were removed
replace_selenium_in_met: replace selenium atoms with sulfur in MET residues of a PDB structure for OpenMM compatibility
remove_single_residue_chains: remove chains containing only a single amino acid from a PDB structure to avoid force template errors
